name: beacon-lens-create
description: Create, revise, debug or validate a Beacon lens, a single HTML file that renders one agent trace as a purpose-built view (a per-file review, a cost breakdown, a timeline of risky commands, a map of tool use) in a sandboxed tab of the local Beacon dashboard, fed once through window.beacon.getTrace().
